data.name: Inquisitor
data.description: [Not Implemented]A character who chooses inquisitor as her secondary class gains the following secondary class features.

raw_tokens.value: [Not Implemented]A character who chooses inquisitor as her secondary class gains the following secondary class features.
&nl;Deity: At 1st level, she must select a deity within one alignment step of her alignment. She gains the inquisitor's code of conduct and restriction on casting spells of opposed alignments.
&nl;Stern Gaze: At 3rd level, she gains the stern gaze class feature, treating her character level as her effective inquisitor level.
&nl;Judgment: At 7th level, once per day, she can use the judgment class feature as an inquisitor of her character level - 3.
&nl;Solo Tactics: At 11th level, she gains the solo tactics class feature.
&nl;Additional Judgment: At 15th level, she can use the judgment class feature twice per day.
&nl;Second Judgment: At 19th level, she gains the second judgment ability.
